overview:
**Fire danger holds at Moderate today, driven by dry mid-level fuels (ERC 61%, BI 58%) despite light winds.**
- Danger stays Moderate through the 7-day outlook, with ERC/BI ticking up slightly midweek (peaking near 66%/62% on Oct 9) before light rain Oct 11–13 nudges fuels down.
- Winds stay light (5–12 mph, NE/ENE) all week; today brings a slight chance of afternoon showers/storms per NWS, with a high near 73.
- 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met, and no Red Flag Warning is active for the area.
- No fire restrictions are currently in effect — BLM's Uncompahgre and Gunnison Field Offices lifted Stage 1 restrictions on September 18, 2026, following earlier eases by Montrose County and GMUG National Forest in September.
- No active wildfires are reported in this area's counties in today's national situation report; the only uncontained large fire nationally is in Wyoming, far outside this zone.
